notes.title: 0.53x0316a - Droid update
notes.notes:
01000100 01110010 01101111 01101001 01100100

Hello everyone who is still here. I'm finally releasing this update in which I've added new droids and a few other features.

Let me start with the most important thing: Droids
For a long time in the game there exists SSDroid, he couldn't do anything, I want to make you happy, he still can't do anything. But now there are other droids in the game, specifically:
[olist]
[*] Collector droid - collects objects flying by.
[*] Mining droid - flying to asteroids and extracts resources from them.
[/olist]

Droids have an energy charge that you can track with the new item Droid Tracker (you need to learn the recipe in Ship core). By taking it in your hands you will see the distance to all droids and their charge.

To work and charge droids you need a Flying Droid Station (you need to learn the recipe in Ship core). This station has a storage where droids will bring resources. 

The Workbench for droids has been reworked

Another important part of this update is the rework of the energy system. Now the devices have the amount of energy they consume. Changed the energy value in the battery from percent to unit. The battery now has an improvement.

Batteries now save energy when you pick them up in your inventory.

That's the main thing I wanted to tell you about this update. Now I want to tell you about the future of this project.
Sometimes I get questions like ‘Is the project dead?’ or something similar. I am preparing a project roadmap where I will try to show what I want to add in future updates. 

In addition to Remains, there are several other projects in development. I would like to concentrate fully on Remains, but it's financially impossible. But that doesn't mean I've abandoned the project and won't update it. I have plans to do a complete visual redesign to get away from assets on my own. I'm also testing the option of landing on a planet. And of course the addition of multiplayer. So I am sure that the project will live,[b] I can not guarantee that updates will be released quickly, but I can say for sure that they will be![/b]

A few words about future projects:
I'm currently in the process of porting my already released game Operation sniff to other platforms. This will help me understand how cross-platform multiplayer works. After the port I will continue to develop another space game, but not in survival genre, but still I hope you will be interested and there will also be multiplayer, but from the release. And one more project that you may have already heard about on my Discord server or read my posts on X. A game in the sea networking very close in concept to Remains. I hope you will enjoy the future projects. Thank you all for reading to the end.

[previewyoutube=1AbVakOlNQk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Fixes and engine update - Ver. 0.26x0486a
notes.notes:
Base, do you copy, over? There was a glitch in the on-board computer and I had to update it ːbigboltː

This small update was mostly bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Boer sound. If a boer breaks while drilling, the sound and effect of the drill at the place where it broke remains.
[*]There was a fix for the localization of the French language. Thanks so much Pertonemos (from the [url=https://discord.gg/rvmxWJ9]discord server[/url]) for the help with it!

Thank you to everyone who takes an interest to the game! ːsapcelootboxː

notes.title: French - Update 0.26x0441a
notes.notes:
Bonjour!

I have noticed a lot of activity from the French orbit over the last few days. In order to understand what was going on I had to reconfigure my onboard computer to their language.

In this update, the French language was added! But unfortunately for me the translation is not perfect. I tried my best to make it as good as I could. Over time I will try to improve the translation of the game and it will get better!

[b]The French language was also added to the demo version![/b]

About the changes:
The main change is a small adjustment of the character stats.
[list]
[*]Time of full use of oxygen in minutes:
[u]Was 7 minutes -> became 8 minutes.[/u]
[*]Time of full use of food in minutes:
[u]Was 12 minutes -> became 16 minutes[/u]
[/list]

Some UI bugs were fixed, such as the pause menu button not playing animation and other similar bugs.
Also, the character controller has been slightly improved.
Preparing to add support for the controller.

notes.title: Update 0.17 - Asteroids, ores and more...
notes.notes:
In this update, I've added a mining system, new resources, recipe changes, tools, and more. I also fixed many bugs and added others :)

[h2]Asteroids and mining:[/h2]
Now you can find asteroids that you can destroy to get ore from them. You can process ore into a Recycler and get a resource for further use.
[h3]Asteroids:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050411/a32552fa473434de8a1d324b03003004db47bb3e.png[/img]

Now there are 5 types of asteroids with ore:
[olist]
[*]Iron
[*]Aluminum
[*]Armirium
[*]Branium
[*]Ebosite
[/olist]
You can get ore from asteroids using a new tool:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050411/d90f72d28d8d46b44af2c8baa1c92f39a37f15ec.png[/img]
[u]To craft, you need to learn the recipe in Shipcore.[/u] Crafting recipe:
[olist]
[*]Electric parts - 3
[*]Plastic - 3
[*]Metal - 3
[/olist]
Ores that you can mine from asteroids:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050411/6caa6c20ea78fca7b44a6a7e39b83b2c53692490.png[/img]

You can process the obtained ores in the Recycler.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050411/e826b815ab02144df68659e7936cf5e66b1e0374.png[/img]

Only ore is needed for processing: Iron ore -> Iron

[h2]Tools strength:[/h2]
In this update, I added durability to items, now they can break with long use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050411/e0d582b0405e8b188c18855e93eb5290fe2e3e06.png[/img]

To repair tools you will need to create a Repair Table:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050411/1ad5b08de0403b08a29a5f04323d4feb28f47488.png[/img]
[u]To craft, you need to learn the recipe in Shipcore.[/u] Crafting recipe:
[olist]
[*]Iron - 1
[*]Plastic - 3
[*]Rubber - 3
[/olist]
[h3]Energy:[/h3]
Added solar panel. [b]Can only be connected to battery[/b] to generate power.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050411/1d584d4e1200069dec1d19b6780490318edd4a8d.png[/img]
[u]To craft, you need to learn the recipe in Shipcore.[/u] Crafting recipe:
[olist]
[*]Branium - 1
[*]Processor - 2 
[*]Metal - 3
[/olist]
[h3]Mechanics:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now you can turn on the function of losing items after death (In New game or Load game)
[*] Now the time of day has appeared. The planet is now orbiting the sun
[*] An option has been added to enable automatic speed stabilization. Look in the settings!
How it works: 
When the control buttons are inactive, the speed is automatically reduced
[/list]
New tool Gravity hook. Can help you with loot items:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050411/84eeff4da35206652a04075b72e7908ca706376a.png[/img]
[u]To craft, you need to learn the recipe in Shipcore.[/u] Crafting recipe:
[olist]
[*]Ebosite - 1
[*]Metal part - 10
[*]Wire - 5
[/olist]
[h3]Settings:[/h3]
[list]
[*]X, Y camera inversion
[/list]
[h3]Recipes changes:[/h3]
Energy batterie:
[olist]
[*]Bolt
[*]Electric parts
[*]Rubber -> Aluminum
[/olist]
3D Printer:
[olist]
[*]Bolt
[*]Wire -> Branium
[*]Metal
[/olist]
Trash trap:
[olist]
[*]Ebosite
[*]Bolt
[*]Metal part
[/olist]
Ship Engine:
[olist]
[*]Added -> Armirium
[*]Processor
[*]Metal
[/olist]
[h3]News and bugs fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Broken size of the settings window on some monitors.
[*] The game freezes while saving.
[*] Fixed a bug with assigning the same button in the control settings.
[*] Adding plastic to the generator at 100%.
[*] Dup in a processor and 3D printer.
[*] Correction of fonts in some languages.
[*] Minor localization changes.
[*] Endless loading of the game.
[*] Items disappear when trying to transfer from the chest to inventory.
[*] Fixed a bug with the work of tool animations.
[*] Automatic addition of a backpack to the cell.
[*] Add a backpack to the cell with the left button.
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect rendering of device previews.
[*] The brightness of the planet decreases when it is on the sunny side.
[*] Removed the sign in the main menu "You are playing early access".
[*] Added a scene describing early access.
[*] Once saved, you cannot detach the wires from the devices.
[*] Solved the problem of phantom wires.
[*] Fixed a large number of bugs with wires and devices.
[/list]
And lot of little fixes!

notes.title: Changelog from Patch 0.11 — 10.06.2021 to 0.13 — 04.07.2021
notes.notes:
Patch 0.11  — 10.06.2021
-Fixes and changes:
1. Black boxes do not spawn - Now spawn near destroyed ships
2. The trash trap animation does not turn off when the device is full
3. Shipcore UI speed
4. Components in the 3D printer wrong names
5. Wiring can no longer connect to overflowing generators / batteries
6. Low oxygen alert now turns on from 25%
7. The world file (.world) is now independent of the file name
8. "The problem of two chests" chests now work correctly
9. Shipcore does not waste battery power

Patch 0.12 — 14.06.2021
-In this patch, I optimized the code and fixed some bugs:
1. Items stopped spawning if game paused for a long time
2. At Shipcore, learning recipes was taking more resources than needed
3. Hunger now deals less damage
4. Increased spawn speed of items (from 1s/item to 0.7s/item)
5. Added color in energy status (Shipcore/3D printer etc.)
6. Now you can craft items using resources from an open chest
7. World delete button (Press the button 5 times)
8. Fixed several bugs causing disabling gravity
9. Loading the world a little faster

Patch 0.13 — 21.06.2021
New:
1. Backpack
2. Now you can configure control in the settings (in the future, the number of settings will be more)

Bugs:
1. When closing the chest due to the distance, the item icon breaks
2. Infinite energy between batteries
3. Craft UI is not updated when using items from the chest
4. Colliders on destroyed ships

Patch with backpack fixes — 22.06.2021

New in game: — 29.06.2021
1. The journal has been added
2. Improved crafting, now you can use items from the backpack
3. Now, when the engine is turned on, the ship will smoothly pick up speed

Most of the time I've been reworking terrible code 💩, so there isn't a lot of content in this update.

Backpack patch — 01.07.2021
1. You can now use items from the backpack when building, repairing, etc.
2. Items that were picked up now stack in the backpack
3. Minor UI changes

notes.notes:
If this does not fix with last patch, then try to go to the game folder and delete:
*Game folder*/Remains_Data/settings.data
